choices.label: Fill the granary
choices.description: Store what can be stored and let the rest feed the road crews.

choices.label: Sell the surplus
choices.description: Send the carts to the nearest market before the grain turns.

choices.label: Douse the works
choices.description: Pay the bucket lines and the carters, and lose only the racks.

choices.label: Let it burn out
choices.description: Keep the coin and rebuild the quarter when the ash cools.

choices.label: Shelter the people
choices.description: Close the works and open the stores until the squall passes.

choices.label: Keep the works open
choices.description: Pay danger wages and sweep the roofs as they fill; the quarter suffers for it.

choices.label: Lodge them
choices.description: Feed and house them through the winter and copy what they carry.

choices.label: Charge them passage
choices.description: Let them pass through for a fee and keep the winter stores for your own.

choices.label: Open the fissure
choices.description: Let the Waykeepers read the fresh glass before it is filled, whatever it costs the terraces.

choices.label: Seal it
choices.description: Pay the masons to fill and cap the fissure before anyone falls in.

choices.label: Take them in
choices.description: Open the gate and the stores; they will work the land by spring.

choices.label: Turn them away
choices.description: Point them down the road and keep the stores for the levy.

choices.label: Salvage it
choices.description: Put the carters to the timber and the hull and sell what the shipwrights will take.

choices.label: Leave it to the fishers
choices.description: Let the fishing families take the wrack and the catch that shelters in it.

choices.label: Rebuild it
choices.description: Pay the masons to raise the quarter properly this time.

choices.label: Clear the rubble
choices.description: Clear the lane and leave the quarter as open ground.

choices.label: Dry the ledger
choices.description: Set the scribes to the ledger before the pages rot; the strongbox pays for their time.

choices.label: Keep the strongbox
choices.description: Count the coin and let the ledger go back to the sea.

choices.label: Dredge the channel
choices.description: Pay the dredging crews and keep the quays working.

choices.label: Work the shallows
choices.description: Let the boats work what water is left and put the crews to the mudflats.

choices.label: Save the shelves
choices.description: Turn out the whole quarter with buckets; the archive stands, the lanes do not.

choices.label: Save the quarter
choices.description: Let the archive burn and keep the fire from the houses; what was written is lost.

choices.label: Pay the fee
choices.description: Pay in coin and copy every reading.

choices.label: Ask the favour
choices.description: Feed and house the Witness for the season instead.

choices.label: Open the stores
choices.description: Feed the sick well and lose only the food.

choices.label: Ration the sick
choices.description: Keep the stores for the people; the companies recover thinner.

choices.label: Pay the drill
choices.description: Pay the veteran and put the companies through the yard every morning.

choices.label: Thank the veteran
choices.description: Keep the coin and the companies as they are.

choices.label: Work the vein
choices.description: Pay the quarrymen to cut it out carefully.

choices.label: Sell the cut
choices.description: Take what breaks free and sell it on the road.

choices.label: Grant the fair
choices.description: Take the tolls and let the realm see what the road brings.

choices.label: Hold it inside the walls
choices.description: Bring the fair into the market square and feed it from the stores.

choices.label: Share the stores
choices.description: Send carts out along the roads; the realm remembers it.

choices.label: Send them home
choices.description: Keep the stores where they are and the elders go home unheard.

choices.label: Send a relief train
choices.description: Pay the carters to bring grain from the older hearths.

choices.label: Let them manage
choices.description: The settlers eat what they have and lose a little of what they built.

choices.label: Open the gate
choices.description: House them a night; some stay, and they leave what they know of the road.

choices.label: Sell them provisions
choices.description: Water is free; the rest is not.

choices.label: Pay the hunters
choices.description: Hire hunters to clear the woods and keep the farms working.

choices.label: Bring the herds in
choices.description: Pen the herds inside the walls and feed them from the granary.

choices.label: Leave the farms
choices.description: Abandon the outlying farms until spring.

choices.label: Take the warehouse
choices.description: Sell its stock.

choices.label: Take the library
choices.description: Carry the books to the nearest archive.

choices.label: Dig a new well
choices.description: Pay the diggers and the masons.

choices.label: Haul water
choices.description: Haul water from the river until the well clears; the sick are not all saved.

choices.label: Repair the walls
choices.description: Put the idle hands to the walls and the lanes.

choices.label: Hold a festival
choices.description: Open the stores and let the hearth feast; it will be remembered.

choices.label: Leave them to it
choices.description: Close the lower terraces and let them listen.

choices.label: Quiet the seam
choices.description: Spend ashglass to damp the seam before the windows break.

choices.label: Close the lanes
choices.description: Shut the lower lanes, feed the shut-in from the stores and pay the surgeons; it goes no further.

choices.label: Let it run
choices.description: Keep the lanes open and the works going; what follows, follows.

choices.label: Quarantine the quarter
choices.description: Wall off the sick quarter and pay for its keeping; the lanes inside suffer.

choices.label: Pray it passes
choices.description: Keep the hearth open and bury who must be buried.

choices.label: Bury the dead
choices.description: Dig the pits beyond the walls and let the quarter stand empty.

choices.label: Burn the quarter
choices.description: Burn the sick quarter to end it; fewer die, and the quarter is gone.

choices.label: Pay them off
choices.description: Send coin up the ridge and they ride on.

choices.label: Muster the levy
choices.description: Call the levy in from the farms, feed it, and let the riders see the walls manned.

choices.label: Bar the gates
choices.description: Bar the gates and wait them out.

choices.label: Sally out
choices.description: Send the companies out after them; it costs them, and the farms burn a little.

choices.label: Endure the raid
choices.description: Keep the gates shut and count the losses when they are gone.

choices.label: Gather the plunder
choices.description: Bring it in to the stores and the treasury.

choices.label: Return it to the farms
choices.description: Give it back where it was taken; the farms recover and remember.

choices.label: Raise the levees
choices.description: Pay the diggers now and see whether the levees hold.

choices.label: Wait and see
choices.description: The river has risen before and gone down again.

choices.label: Open the sluices
choices.description: Let the silt onto the fields for the spring.

choices.label: Keep the works
choices.description: Keep the diggers on and learn the river’s measure.

choices.label: Rebuild the fields
choices.description: Pay to drain and reterrace the lower fields.

choices.label: Move the fields uphill
choices.description: Give up the lower fields and break new ground above the flood line.

choices.label: Lower the toll
choices.description: Settle it cheaply; the road stays open and some of the carters stay.

choices.label: Hold the toll
choices.description: Clear the wagons and take the toll; the gate quarter pays for the quarrel.

choices.label: Post the wardens
choices.description: Lend the company to the road; it comes back thinner and paid.

choices.label: Keep them home
choices.description: The company stays at the hearth and the carters ward themselves.

choices.label: Send surveyors
choices.description: Pay a party to walk the ridge and write down what it finds.

choices.label: Ignore the rumours
choices.description: Glass sings in every tavern.

choices.label: Admit them
choices.description: Let them in to the lower terraces and learn what they carry from other seams.

choices.label: Charge them
choices.description: Sell them a look from the wall.

choices.label: Raise a subscription
choices.description: Let the hearth subscribe to the realm’s own future; it pays, and quarrels over it.

choices.label: Calm the hearth
choices.description: Open the stores and the archive and let the talk burn down.

choices.label: Take the house’s share
choices.description: Licence the wagers and take a share of every book.

choices.label: Forbid the wagers
choices.description: Close the books and put the bookmakers’ clerks to the archive.

choices.label: Let them pass freely
choices.description: Open the road and the place; they leave coin at the stones and stories in the lanes.

choices.label: Charge a toll
choices.description: Set a warden on the road and take coin from every pilgrim; the camp is trampled and resented.

choices.label: License the dig
choices.description: Take a fee and set a clerk over the pit; whatever they bring up comes to the hearth in a few turns.

choices.label: Drive them off
choices.description: Send the watch to fill the pit and turn the diggers out; the place stays as it was.

choices.label: Keep the find
choices.description: Pay the diggers off and send the find to the archive; the clerks will be years reading it.

choices.label: Sell the find
choices.description: Let the diggers sell it on and take the hearth’s share.

choices.label: Pay the keeper
choices.description: Grant the stipend; she knows every stone of the place and tells the clerks what they ask.

choices.label: Leave it to the hearth
choices.description: The hearth keeps its own places; she goes on as before, unpaid, and the coin stays.

choices.label: Set them back
choices.description: Pay masons to set every stone where it stood and hold a rite over it; the fields are worked again.

choices.label: Let them lie
choices.description: Stones are stones; the fields beside the place lie fallow a season.

choices.label: Hold the festival
choices.description: Feed the hearth at the place for three days; the traders come, and the hearth remembers the year.

choices.label: Keep it within the walls
choices.description: Hold the festival in the square as every year; the place stays quiet.

choices.label: Grind the seed grain
choices.description: Feed the hearth through the winter on next year’s seed.

choices.label: Buy grain on the roads
choices.description: Pay the carters’ winter price and keep the seed for the spring.

choices.label: Pay the wardens
choices.description: Pay the bar down and keep the carts moving.

choices.label: Bar the gate to them
choices.description: Shut the gate on the wardens; the hearth keeps its coin, and the carts stop until they go.

choices.label: Close the rooms
choices.description: Send the clerks home and pay them to stay there; the work waits.

choices.label: Keep them at it
choices.description: The ledgers are closed and the fever takes who it takes.

choices.label: Rebuild the cistern
choices.description: Pay the masons to rebuild it on sounder ground; the lanes are mended with it.

choices.label: Patch it
choices.description: Stop the crack with clay and hope; the lanes stay wet and the stores stay short.

choices.label: Guarantee the market
choices.description: Stand behind the merchants’ debts from the treasury; the square settles.

choices.label: Let it run
choices.description: Take the hearth’s due from the wreck and let the merchants settle their own.

choices.label: Bring it in early
choices.description: Pay every hand in the hearth to cut the crop green and under cover.

choices.label: Leave it standing
choices.description: Let it stand; what the dark spares is sold as fodder.

choices.label: Let him stay
choices.description: Leave him his place; what he tells the farmers finds its way to the archive.

choices.label: Move him on
choices.description: Send the watch to turn him off the realm’s land; the farmers grumble and give nothing.

choices.label: Set a watch
choices.description: Pay a watch at the place; the stone stays and the carts go elsewhere.

choices.label: Sell the stone yourself
choices.description: If it is going, it goes at the hearth’s price; the place is diminished.

choices.label: Raise it again
choices.description: Pay masons to raise the place in new stone; the pilgrims return in time.

choices.label: Let it lie
choices.description: Footings are footings; the fields take the ground.

choices.label: Grant the market
choices.description: Take a stall fee and let the market stand; the lanes of the hearth fill on market days.

choices.label: Forbid it
choices.description: The old place is no market; the traders go to the next hearth and so do the fees.

choices.label: Pay for the tales
choices.description: Pay the fee and set a clerk to write the tales down.

choices.label: Send them on their way
choices.description: The hearth knows its own place; the travellers leave with their tales.

choices.label: Fight the fire
choices.description: Turn out every hand to beat the fire back from the place; the fields beside it are trampled.

choices.label: Let it burn to the stones
choices.description: Stone does not burn; the grass does, and the ash feeds next year’s crop.

choices.label: Pay for clean seed
choices.description: Pay the carters’ price and sow clean; the fields come through.

choices.label: Sow what we have
choices.description: Sow the hearth’s own seed and hope the blight has passed it by.

choices.label: Pay the thatchers
choices.description: Pay double and have the roofs cleared before the rain.

choices.label: Clear it ourselves
choices.description: Send the hearth’s own people up; some come down cut.

choices.label: Open the doors
choices.description: Sell at the chalked price and bear the loss; the crowd goes home fed.

choices.label: Bar the doors
choices.description: Keep the price and the doors; the crowd breaks something else.

choices.label: Light the lanes
choices.description: Pay for the oil; the night is remembered and the stories told at every door are written down.

choices.label: Keep the oil
choices.description: Oil is dear; the lanes stay dark and the treasury keeps its coin.

choices.label: Feed them
choices.description: Open the granary to every widow; the lanes are mended by hands that have reason to.

choices.label: Turn them to the mills
choices.description: Set them to work for their bread; the mills turn, and the lanes resent it.

choices.label: Take the offer
choices.description: Let the foreigner run the quay; the coin comes in and the clerks learn less of what passes.

choices.label: Keep the quay
choices.description: The quay is the hearth’s; pay its own master a little more.

choices.label: Enforce the roll
choices.description: Collect the old dues; the coin comes in and the lanes remember who kept the roll.

choices.label: Burn the roll
choices.description: Let the old dues go; the clerks copy what the roll says of the hearth’s founding first.

choices.label: Hold the games
choices.description: Pay for the games; the companies come back to the drill ground with their strength up.

choices.label: Keep them at drill
choices.description: No games; the drill goes on and the stores feed it.

choices.label: Let them
choices.description: Ploughshares it is; the fields gain and the companies at the hearth lose their spare iron.

choices.label: Forbid it
choices.description: The spears stay spears; pay the smiths for their idle day.

choices.label: Grant them land
choices.description: Give them a quarter and feed them until the first harvest.

choices.label: Send them home
choices.description: Pay their road home; the hearth keeps its land.

choices.label: Share it out
choices.description: Every household takes its share; the stores fill.

choices.label: Sell it on the road
choices.description: Sell the crop to the carters and keep the seed; the stores stay thin.

choices.label: Dredge it
choices.description: Pay the dredgers; the water runs clear again.

choices.label: Ration the water
choices.description: Measure the water out; the stores are short and the lanes grumble.

choices.label: Take the child in
choices.description: Raise the child at the hearth’s cost; the token goes to the clerks.

choices.label: Send the child to the hospice
choices.description: Pay the hospice to raise the child; the lanes think better of the hearth.

choices.label: Buy the shards
choices.description: Pay his price; the shards are what he says.

choices.label: Charge him a stall
choices.description: Let him sell to who he likes for a fee.

choices.label: Keep out of it
choices.description: Wagers are for merchants; the hearth takes a fee from the table.

choices.label: Stake the treasury
choices.description: Put thirty coin on the hearth’s own judgement; the wager comes due in a few turns.

choices.label: Collect
choices.description: Take the winnings and close the table.

choices.label: Let it ride
choices.description: Leave the stake on the table and buy the merchants’ news with the rest.

choices.label: Gather them
choices.description: Turn out the hearth to the flats before the tide returns.

choices.label: Leave them to the birds
choices.description: The clerks count the birds that come instead.

choices.label: Rebuild the wall
choices.description: Pay the masons to raise it again and clear the lanes.

choices.label: Clear the rubble and sell the stone
choices.description: The lanes are cleared and the dressed stone sold; the gap stays.

choices.label: Cast the bell
choices.description: Pay for the bronze; the bell is rung for every hour and every death, and the lanes keep better time.

choices.label: Sell them the old bell
choices.description: The founders buy the cracked bell for its bronze and move on.

choices.label: Sell the dues
choices.description: Take their coin now; the lanes meet the collectors later.

choices.label: Keep the dues
choices.description: The hearth’s own clerks collect, slowly and honestly.

choices.label: Dig new wells
choices.description: Pay the well-diggers to sink clean wells beyond the ruin.

choices.label: Draw from the river
choices.description: Carry water from the river; the carrying costs the stores and the ruin stays.

choices.label: Render it
choices.description: Turn out the hearth to the flensing; the stores fill and the oil sells.

choices.label: Leave it to the shore folk
choices.description: Let the beach families take it; the clerks draw the skeleton.

choices.label: Send the clerks
choices.description: Pay the clerks to sit the nights out at the seam and write what they see.

choices.label: Toll the seam road
choices.description: Nobody uses the road at night anyway; charge the day traffic for the watch.

choices.label: Hang them
choices.description: The companies see the gibbet and stay in their ranks; the lanes see it too.

choices.label: Pardon and feed them
choices.description: Take them back into the ranks and feed them; the companies are the stronger for it.

choices.label: Let the quay be
choices.description: The quay stays as it is; the merchants pay a fee for the asking.

choices.label: Raise the customs house
choices.description: Pay for the house and the clerks; the dues come in a few turns on.

choices.label: Collect the dues
choices.description: Take the realm’s due and close the books.

choices.label: Publish the books
choices.description: Take less and let the clerks copy the books into the archive, with every cargo named.

choices.label: Buy back copies
choices.description: Send to every archive of the realm for copies of what burned.

choices.label: Let it burn
choices.description: The copies will serve; sell the scorched vellum to the glue-makers.

choices.label: Strike the dead from the rolls
choices.description: The rolls are corrected; the hearth keeps the ration it was paying for ghosts.

choices.label: Fill the rolls
choices.description: Pay to recruit up to the roll from the lanes.

choices.label: Hold the fair
choices.description: Open the gates for three days; the stalls pay and the stores fill.

choices.label: Keep the gates
choices.description: No fair; the clerks buy the carters’ news instead.

choices.label: Resurvey the border
choices.description: Pay a surveyor to walk the line and set new stones; the clerks keep the new map.

choices.label: Let the farms settle it
choices.description: Fine both sides for the trouble and let them argue.

choices.label: Buy fodder
choices.description: Pay the carters for hay; the herd comes through.

choices.label: Cull the herd
choices.description: Slaughter what cannot be fed and salt it down; the hides sell.

choices.label: Pay the debts
choices.description: Pay what is owed; the lanes are easier for it.

choices.label: Refuse them
choices.description: The hearth pays nothing; the lenders close their doors and the lanes feel it.

choices.label: Charter the guild
choices.description: Grant the charter for a fee; the guild’s first buying goes to the realm’s store.

choices.label: Tax them instead
choices.description: No charter; tax every furnace in the lanes.

choices.label: Buy remounts
choices.description: Pay the dealers; the companies at the hearth ride the better for it.

choices.label: Charge the fair
choices.description: Let the dealers pay for the ground and the water.

choices.label: Pay the watch
choices.description: Hire watchmen for the lanes; the thefts stop and the lanes mend.

choices.label: Let the lanes watch themselves
choices.description: No watch; the lanes bar their doors and the hearth keeps its coin.

choices.label: Replant the orchards
choices.description: Buy saplings from the next valley; the growers feed the hearth from the old stock meanwhile.

choices.label: Let the stumps stand
choices.description: Sell the charred wood and leave the orchards to the next generation.

choices.label: Salvage the wrecks
choices.description: Turn out the hearth to strip the hulls; the timber and iron sell.

choices.label: Read the marks on the hulls
choices.description: The clerks copy the yard-marks and the cargo lists before the sea takes the rest.

choices.label: Pay the chanters
choices.description: Pay them; whatever the singing does, the shards come up.

choices.label: Send them off
choices.description: Charge them for the camp and send them down the road; the lanes miss the singing.

choices.label: Raise the levy
choices.description: A household goes to the ranks and the companies are the stronger for it.

choices.label: Keep the fields
choices.description: The hearth keeps its people at the harvest; the companies grumble.

choices.label: Fight the fire
choices.description: Pay every hand on the quay to carry water; the sheds are saved.

choices.label: Save the warehouses
choices.description: Let the quay burn and sell what is carried out of the warehouses; the quay is scarred.

choices.label: Host the chronicler
choices.description: Feed and lodge the chronicler; the archive gains the copies they leave.

choices.label: Charge for the desk
choices.description: A fee for the reading room and nothing more.

choices.label: Punish the companies
choices.description: Flog the ringleaders and dock the ranks; the lanes are satisfied.

choices.label: Pay the damages
choices.description: The hearth pays for the lanes and the companies drill on.

choices.label: Fund the carters
choices.description: Pay for the mending; the carts come in with grain.

choices.label: Tax the carts
choices.description: The carters mend the roads themselves and pay a toll for the trouble.

choices.label: Send aid
choices.description: Send the grain and the coin; the carters come back with the news of the far valleys.

choices.label: Send regrets
choices.description: The hearth keeps its stores and sends a letter.

choices.label: Raise the stockade
choices.description: Pay for the timber; the companies at the hearth hold the better for it.

choices.label: Wait a season
choices.description: Timber is dear; the hearth keeps its coin and its doors.

choices.label: Turn the envoy away
choices.description: The hearth hears no bids; the envoy pays for the night’s lodging.

choices.label: Entertain the envoy
choices.description: Feast the envoy and hear the bid; the clerks write it down, and the envoy promises to return.

choices.label: Take the gift
choices.description: Coin, and the envoy’s thanks.

choices.label: Ask for the books instead
choices.description: The envoy sends the bidder’s ledgers in place of the coin.

choices.label: Burn the field edges
choices.description: Pay the hands to burn the swarm off the edges; some of the crop goes with it.

choices.label: Let them pass
choices.description: The swarm moves on in a week with a tenth of the crop.

choices.label: Set a toll
choices.description: A toll-bar at the gate; the coin comes in and the carters grumble in the lanes.

choices.label: Free passage
choices.description: No toll; the carters bring the hearth the news of the road in thanks.

choices.label: Hold the feast
choices.description: Pay for the ale and the roast; the lanes are the warmer for it.

choices.label: Cancel the feast
choices.description: No feast this year; the wards hold their own and remember.

choices.label: Sell the rubble
choices.description: The dressed stone goes by the cartload; the gap stays a gap.

choices.label: Build from it
choices.description: Pay the masons to raise the quarter from its own stone.

choices.label: Cull the colony
choices.description: Meat and oil for the stores, hides for the market.

choices.label: Leave them the rocks
choices.description: The clerks watch the colony through the season and write what they see.

choices.label: Pay the diggers
choices.description: They cut deeper and the shards come up again.

choices.label: Let the seam rest
choices.description: The diggers go to the fields for a season and the hearth keeps its coin.

choices.label: Take them in
choices.description: Feed and nurse them; those who mend return to the ranks at the hearth.

choices.label: Send them on
choices.description: Pay their carts to the next hearth; the companies here lose the men who would have mended.

choices.label: Pay the pilots
choices.description: Raise the fee; the ships come in with their holds full.

choices.label: License new pilots
choices.description: Sell licences to any who claim to know the bar; some do.

choices.label: Compile the ledger
choices.description: Pay the clerks for the winter; the hearth knows its dead and its living.

choices.label: Shelve the idea
choices.description: The clerks go back to the tax rolls.

choices.label: Hire the sergeant
choices.description: Pay the season; the companies come off the drill ground the better.

choices.label: Send him off
choices.description: The hearth trusts its own sergeants and charges him for his lodging.

choices.label: Stand the dower
choices.description: Pay the dower; the houses are bound and the lanes feast.

choices.label: Decline
choices.description: The houses pay their own dower and the hearth takes a fee for the hall.

choices.label: Fund the survey
choices.description: A season of surveyors; the maps of the far holdings are drawn.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.description: The far holdings keep their own counsel.

choices.label: Dig the well
choices.description: Pay the well-diggers; the households keep their hours for the fields.

choices.label: Carry water
choices.description: The stream will do another season; the hearth keeps its coin.

choices.label: Burn the stock
choices.description: Burn the suspect shards in the square; the lanes are calmed.

choices.label: Deny it
choices.description: The clerks read the rumour down in the square; the lanes do not believe them.

choices.label: Hear nothing
choices.description: The hearth carries no one’s word; both envoys pay for their lodging.

choices.label: Send a counter-envoy
choices.description: Send the hearth’s own envoy to both courts with the hearth’s terms; the answer comes in a few turns.

choices.label: Accept the terms
choices.description: Coin for the hearth’s word.

choices.label: Keep the letters
choices.description: The clerks copy the letters of both courts into the archive instead.

choices.label: Count the doors
choices.description: Pay the clerks a season; the hearth knows what it holds.

choices.label: Trust the rolls
choices.description: The old rolls will serve; the clerks go back to the tolls.

choices.label: Bring in casks
choices.description: Pay for casks from the next valley; the lanes are easier for it.

choices.label: Ration the ale
choices.description: A measure a head and a fee for the measure; the wards grumble.

choices.label: Let them stay
choices.description: They are households now; the quarter is lived in, if not mended.

choices.label: Clear them out
choices.description: The watch turns them out and the masons have the quarter to themselves.

choices.label: Lend the carts
choices.description: Pay the carters; the fields are fed with wrack for a season.

choices.label: Leave it to rot
choices.description: The shore folk carry what they can; the hearth keeps its carts.

choices.label: Vent the cut
choices.description: Pay for shafts and bellows; the diggers go back down slowly.

choices.label: Dig on
choices.description: The shards come up and the sick are carried to the lanes.

choices.label: Press the smiths
choices.description: The forges ring for the companies; the hearth pays the smiths’ loss.

choices.label: Keep the forges
choices.description: The smiths work for the market; the companies make do.

choices.label: Pay a keeper
choices.description: A keeper’s wage; the boats come in by night as before.

choices.label: Let it go dark
choices.description: The boats wait for dawn; a hull is lost on the bar before the season ends.

choices.label: Lend the books
choices.description: Pay the copyists; the archive grows by what comes back.

choices.label: Refuse the scholar
choices.description: The books stay; the scholar pays to read them in the hall.

choices.label: Stand the feast
choices.description: Pay the hall; the companies and the lanes are bound the closer.

choices.label: A quiet wedding
choices.description: The captain marries in the chapel and the hearth takes a fee for the hall.

choices.label: Grant the charter
choices.description: Two market days; the tolls double and the lanes are the busier.

choices.label: Keep the market day
choices.description: One market day; the clerks write down what the merchants bring.

choices.label: Accept the tithe
choices.description: Take what came; the letter goes in the archive.

choices.label: Send assessors
choices.description: Pay assessors to ride out; the hearth learns what the far holdings hold.

choices.label: Plant the orchard
choices.description: Pay for the saplings; the slope bears in a few years.

choices.label: Sow the slope
choices.description: Barley on the slope this year and the coin kept.

choices.label: Give the tithe
choices.description: Shards for the shrine; the lanes are the calmer for the priests’ blessing.

choices.label: Refuse the priests
choices.description: The shards stay in the stores and the priests preach against the hearth.

choices.label: Decline the wager
choices.description: The hearth lays no wager; the clerks note what the agent let slip.

choices.label: Take the coin
choices.description: The coin now, the stake in a few turns when the wager is settled.

choices.label: Pay the stake
choices.description: The stake is paid and the agent goes.

choices.label: Refuse to pay
choices.description: The agent’s men break heads in the lanes before the watch turns them out.

choices.label: Mend the road
choices.description: Pay the menders; the carts come and go the easier and the clerks learn what they carry.

choices.label: Let it rut
choices.description: The carters mend their own axles and pay the gate for the trouble.

choices.label: Judge it
choices.description: Pay for a second well and the hall’s judgment; the wards keep the peace.

choices.label: Let them settle it
choices.description: The wards settle it in the lanes and the hall fines the loser.

choices.label: Sell the rights
choices.description: The salvagers pay and pick the quarter clean.

choices.label: Keep the timber
choices.description: Pay the hearth’s own folk to sort the timber for rebuilding.

choices.label: Take the cargo
choices.description: Casks for the stores and the strongbox for the hall.

choices.label: Return it
choices.description: Send word down the coast; the owner’s factor comes with thanks and news.

choices.label: Sell the year
choices.description: The coin now; the shards go to the merchants as they come up.

choices.label: Keep the shards
choices.description: The hearth sells by the shard; the merchants leave a small earnest behind.

choices.label: Send the levy
choices.description: The young men march and the stores feed them on the road.

choices.label: Buy them out
choices.description: Pay the marshal in coin instead; a few go of their own will.

choices.label: Dredge the channel
choices.description: Pay the dredgers; the deep hulls come in with their holds full.

choices.label: Wait for the tide
choices.description: The hulls lighter in by boat and pay for the trouble; one grounds.

choices.label: Raise their pay
choices.description: Pay the copyists; the archive’s backlog is cleared by winter.

choices.label: Replace them
choices.description: Hire boys from the lanes; the hearth keeps its coin and loses a shelf of work.

choices.label: Forbid it
choices.description: The hall forbids it and pays for a feast to make the peace.

choices.label: Let them fight
choices.description: One captain is carried off the field; the hall fines the other.

choices.label: Toll the bridge
choices.description: A toll-bar on the bridge; the coin comes in and the carters grumble.

choices.label: Keep the bridge free
choices.description: The carters cross freely and bring the hearth their news and their surplus.

choices.label: Send gifts
choices.description: Pay for gifts and the witness’s road; the witness comes back with the far holding’s news.

choices.label: Send a letter
choices.description: A letter and the hearth’s regrets; the far holding’s factor pays the clerk.

choices.label: Build the mill
choices.description: Pay the millwright; the households keep their hours for the fields.

choices.label: Grind by hand
choices.description: The querns will do another season; the hearth keeps its coin.

choices.label: Give the glass
choices.description: Shards for the lanterns; the lanes are lit and the makers pay a share.

choices.label: Refuse the makers
choices.description: The shards stay in the stores; the makers pay for what the market has.

choices.label: Refuse the bribe
choices.description: The clerks refuse and write down what the agent wanted.

choices.label: Take the bribe
choices.description: The coin now; whether the bribe is found out is known in a few turns.

choices.label: Pay the fine
choices.description: The fine is paid and the clerks keep their posts.

choices.label: Deny it
choices.description: The clerks are dismissed and the lanes talk of nothing else.
